note: Knowledge checks are a reading check only. A pass on them is not verified practical competence.

knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A single reading with no method or baseline cannot prove drying.
Comparability depends on the method. Without it, a reading has no value for comparison.

practicalCriteria: The learner records the method, instrument, material, location and baseline for each reading.
The learner does not use a single reading as proof of drying.
Learner completes the procedure record for the mock case and names the stop-work trigger before any practical step.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Completed mock decision record for the lesson case
Assessor observation of the simulated scenario, with no real site work or hazardous material
stopWorkCriteria: A moisture reading has no recorded method or baseline and is being used as a result.
Reinstatement is proposed on a single reading.
